translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: A Jehová, Dios Axon̈ejochi, a ix loloni. Ix yavtej eb' cajan d'a yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic, b'aj sjavi c'u masanto b'aj tz'em c'u.
A d'a tzalan Sion, aton chon̈ab' te vach' yilji, ata' sch'ox saquilq'uinal Dios.
Tic sja co Diosal, palta man̈ ichn̈ejoctalaj ol javoc. A d'a spatic yichan̈ ay jun c'ac' to satumeli yed' jun chacxuxum ic'.
Ato d'a chaan̈ tz'avtaj eb' aj satchaan̈ yed' eb' cajan d'a sat lum luum tic yuj Dios, yic vach' syil eb' sch'olb'itaj schon̈ab'.
Syal Dios icha tic: Molb'ejec e b'a ex vicxo, a ex eyac'nac jun silab' d'ayin, ayic eyac'annac e trato ved'oc, xchi.
A satchaan̈ sch'oxani to a Dios Juez ton d'a stojolal.
Syalanpax Dios icha tic: Ex in chon̈ab' Israel, ab'ecnab'i, jichan ol vutej valanoch e paltail d'a e sat. A in Dios in, e Diosal in.
Maj ex in tumejlaj yuj eyofrenda tzeyac'taxon d'ayin yed' noc' noc' tze n̈us silab'il d'ayin d'a valtar.
Max in c'anlaj noc' quelemtac vacax molb'il eyuuj. Malaj noc' mam chiva d'a yol e macte' tzin c'an d'ayex.
Vicn̈ej masanil noc' caltacte'al noc', vic pax noc' molb'etzal noc' ay d'a jolomtac vitz.
Vic masanil noc' much ay d'a caltac te' yed' masanil tas tz'ec' d'a cal vayumtac.
Q'uinaloc ay in vejel, man̈ ol val-laj d'ayex, yujto vic jun yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic yed' masanil tas ay d'ay.
¿Tocval a sb'ac'chil noc' vacax tzin chi'a? ¿Tocval a pax schiq'uil noc' mam chiva svuq'uej?
A silab' tzin nib'ej, to tzeyac' yuj diosal d'ayin, tzeyaq'uelc'och tas tzeyaltej d'ayin, a in ton ec' in to d'a yib'an̈ smasanil.
Ayic ay eyaelal, avtejinec, ol ex in colo', a exxo ol in eyic'chaan̈, xchi Dios.
Axo d'a eb' chuc sb'eyb'al, syal Dios icha tic: ¿Toc ay eyalan eyic eyalanel in c'ayb'ub'al, ma eyalanel yab'ixal in trato?
Ina to max yal-laj e c'ool tzex in cacha', malaj yelc'och in lolonel d'ayex.
Ayic sja vin̈ elc'umtaxoni, tzex q'ue urnaj e b'at yed' vin̈. Te vach' eyac'anpax yed' eb' sc'ulan ajmulal.
Palta a tas tze c'ulej, to tze naq'ue lolonel, max ex och vaan eyesani.
A d'a eb' eyuc'tac junn̈ej e nun yed'oc, tzeyal chucal lolonel d'a spatic eb'.
Ayic ix e c'ulan juntzan̈ chucal tic, malaj tas svala'. Yuj chi' tze na' to lajan in eyed'oc, palta ol valoch e mul chi' d'a e sat, ol vil-lajoch in sat eyed'oc.
A ex tzin b'at satc'olal eyuuj tic, vach'ocab' tz'aj snachajel jun tic eyuuj, axo talaj tz'aji, ol ex in jatchitejb'ati, man̈xalaj mach ol ex colan d'ayin.
A mach tz'ac'an yuj diosal d'ayin, ay velc'och d'a yol sat. A mach tzin c'anab'ajani, ol in colcaneli, xchi Dios.
